title: Keep POST immutable-validation diagnostics from inheriting a confirmation GET status
outcome: Local immutable-request validation and success diagnostics associate HTTP status with the response that supplied it.
acceptance: A POST201/GET200 control cannot report GET's200 as a POST response in immutable validation or success.
An immutable-request-change control pins the correct phase/status attribution while still refusing execution.
Relevant authorized tests pass with host-recorded evidence.
